title: salix livida var. occidentalis
intro: Salix livida var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Purple Willow, is a plant species belonging to the Salicaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to western North America, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The Western Purple Willow has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
